title: Technical Account Manager
description:
About the client

• Our client is a global leading, end-to-end enterprise volunteer engagement platform powering over 100 million volunteer hours. They exist to connect communities to events and causes they are passionate about. Used by over 3 million volunteers across 26 different countries, their SaaS platform powers mass volunteer programs across the globe for Not-for-Profits, local government, sporting federations, and major events. Our all in one solution helps our clients to recruit, retain, reward and train their volunteers, whilst also ensuring compliance.

About Teamified

•
Teamified is a talent partner helping companies build exceptional remote teams across IT, software, product, and digital innovation. We collaborate with leading enterprises and fast-scaling tech businesses worldwide to help them access world class talent and accelerate growth. With operations across the globe our mission is to make building high performing global teams simple, fast, and cost-effective. Teamified has hundreds of clients with more than 200 engineers, testers, product managers, designers, and technology experts delivering impactful solutions every day.

Job Summary:

• We’re looking for a Technical Account Manager who can be deployed into our customer accounts to deeply understand their technical landscape, diagnose challenges, and architect solutions that drive meaningful outcomes. This role sits at the intersection of technical consulting and account management - you’ll be equally comfortable reviewing a customer’s platform configuration as you are presenting a strategic roadmap to their leadership team. You’ll act as a trusted technical advisor to our most important accounts, combining deep product expertise with a commercial mindset focused on retention, expansion, and long-term customer success. You are not a support agent - you operate above day-to-day support, developing a thorough understanding of each customer’s environment, workflows, and business objectives so they never have to re-explain their setup.

• Serve as the primary technical point of contact for a portfolio of strategic accounts, owning the technical relationship from post-sale through renewal and beyond

• Monitor support request trends across assigned accounts, aggregating common issues to drive broader improvements (training, documentation, product enhancements)

• Identify and progress expansion opportunities including upsell, cross-sell, and professional services by uncovering unmet technical needs

title: Associate Director, Payments/Scheme Economics
description:
ABOUT AIRWALLEX

Airwallex is the only unified payments and financial platform for global businesses. Powered by our unique combination of proprietary infrastructure and software, we empower over 250,000 businesses worldwide - including Brex, Navan, Qantas, SHEIN and many more - with fully integrated solutions to manage everything from business accounts, payments, spend management and treasury, to embedded finance at a global scale.

Proudly founded in Melbourne, we have a team of over 2,300 of the brightest and most innovative people in tech across 27 offices around the globe. Valued at US$11 billion and backed by world-leading investors including T. Rowe Price, Visa, Mastercard, Robinhood Ventures, Sequoia, Salesforce Ventures, DST Global, and Lone Pine Capital, Airwallex is leading the charge in building the global payments and financial platform of the future. If you’re ready to do the most ambitious work of your career, join us.

 

ATTRIBUTES WE VALUE

We hire successful builders with founder-like energy who want real impact, accelerated learning, and true ownership. You bring strong role-related expertise and sharp thinking, and you’re motivated by our mission and operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/us/operating-principles. You move fast with good judgment, dig deep with curiosity, and make decisions from first principles, balancing speed and rigor.

You're humble and collaborative; turn zero‑to‑one ideas into real products, and you “get stuff done” end-to-end. You use AI to work smarter and solve problems faster. Here, you’ll tackle complex, high‑visibility problems with exceptional teammates and grow your career as we build the future of global banking. If that sounds like you, let’s build what’s next.

 

WHO YOU ARE

We are looking for an Associate Director, Payments/Scheme Economics to own the integrity, visibility and management of Airwallex’s payment costs, starting with card scheme fees and interchange fees across Visa and Mastercard.

Reporting to the Head of Strategic Finance, you will be the subject matter expert on scheme economics, translating complex and rapidly changing network rules into accurate system configurations, financial outcomes and business decisions. You will ensure we understand what every payment should cost, that those costs are accurately reflected across our systems and financials, and that we systematically identify opportunities to improve payment economics as we scale.

Over time, the remit will expand across other card schemes, local payment methods and the broader payments cost base.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Own scheme economics and rule interpretation: Maintain deep expertise across scheme fees, interchange and network rules. Interpret scheme bulletins, operating regulations and fee schedules, translating changes into clear financial, product and operational requirements.

- Ensure accurate payment cost configuration: Translate complex scheme rules into fee tables, eligibility criteria and transaction-level logic. Partner with Product and Engineering to ensure cost calculation, allocation and customer billing accurately reflect current network rules across markets and payment flows.

- Protect payment cost integrity: Establish robust governance, testing and controls across scheme configurations. Reconcile expected costs against actual network charges, identify anomalies and leakage, and drive root-cause resolution.

- Build granular visibility into payment economics: Develop robust models and analytics across markets, products, payment methods and transaction types, creating a clear view of unit economics, margin drivers and cost movements.

- Drive structural cost and margin optimization: Identify, quantify and execute opportunities to improve economics through transaction qualification, BIN routing, cost configuration, and other levers. Partner with Product, Finance and Commercial teams to prioritize the highest-value opportunities.

Company Introduction:

Airspace is a tech-enabled freight forwarder that’s redefining how the world’s most critical packages are delivered. Headquartered in Carlsbad, California, Airspace has employees who are based around the world. Our European headquarters is in Amsterdam, The Netherlands.

As a recognized leader in AI and machine learning, our team leverages data and patented technology to coordinate logistics across a global network of drivers and airlines. Our goal is to deliver those packages that are truly mission-critical in a way that is faster, more transparent, more secure, and more accountable than ever before. The items we deliver range from organs for transplant, to parts for critical machinery including grounded aircraft and highly sensitive components such as semiconductors.  

Airspace has been rated one of  America’s best Startup Employers and listed as one of  CNBC’s Disruptor 50 companies. Airspace has the support of leading investors such as Telstra Ventures, HarbourVest Partners, Defy Partners, DBL Partners, and Scale Ventures. To date the company has raised more than $140m. 

The company is growing rapidly and serving more places around the world than ever before. We are looking for passionate, motivated individuals who want to make an IMPACT every day to help us execute on our mission of reshaping the world of time-critical logistics. 

 

What is the "Dedicated Driver" service?

Airspace partners with leading U.S. Medical Device companies to ensure life-saving equipment is transported safely and securely to hospitals in the local region. If a loved one suffers a serious injury, our Dedicated Drivers are the critical link between warehouses and hospitals, delivering essential surgical tools in real time. Their mission is clear: to equip surgeons with the critical tools for life-saving procedures-because every second counts when a patient is on the table.

Reporting to the Manager, DD Operational Support, this role sits alongside recruiting and support functions within the DD Operational Support Team.

This is a detail-oriented, process-driven role best suited for someone who is organized, discreet with sensitive information, and comfortable managing recurring documentation and scheduling cycles across multiple stakeholders at once.

As the Dedicated Driver program continues to grow, this role is expected to grow with it. The responsibilities outlined here represent the current scope, and the right candidate should be comfortable taking on new tasks and workflows as the team's needs develop over time.

title: Account Executive (AE)
description:
About OptimaFI

OptimaFI helps community financial institutions (CFIs) - credit unions and banks profitably grow using a combination of proven data assets, expert consulting, and modern cloud software. We are OptimaFI , striving to create solutions for CFI’s that enable better decision making, transparency, and improved profitability for our clients. Our values are Curiosity, Transparency, Partnership, and Lagniappe - always adding a little extra for clients and colleagues alike. We are an 80-person company growing to 100 in the next 18 months, and we have no intention of ballooning headcount for the sake of it. We move with purpose, invest in what works, and use automation and AI to stay lean and effective.

The Opportunity

OptimaFI already serves a meaningful share of the community financial institution market across software and services. This role is about accelerating software revenue with an experienced seller who can create pipelines, grow existing relationships, and close business across the portfolio. You own the territory and the work required to make it productive.

You will sell to banks and credit unions where reputation matters, and the market is finite. That means relevant outreach, strong discovery, and disciplined follow-through. Find the right institution, understand the need, connect it to the right solution, and keep the deal moving.

Key Responsibilities

•
Create the pipeline. Prospect through account research, direct outreach, relationships, referrals, events, and the existing client base. Be able to show what you personally created.

•
Own the territory. Build software revenue across both net-new institutions and current OptimaFI clients. Know where the best opportunities are and why.

•
Run strong discovery. Understand the institution's stated needs, connect it to the right solution, and know when to bring in a technical specialist.

•
Move the deal. Set clear next steps, maintain momentum, navigate objections and procurement, and carry qualified opportunities through close.

•
Keep the forecast real. Maintain accurate stages, buyer contacts, timing, next steps, and close dates in Salesforce. Requalify or close what is not moving.

•
Open doors for services. Identify qualified service needs and hand them to the right Services seller with the buyer need, context, and next step intact.

•
Help us learn. Record why opportunities advanced, stalled, were won, or were lost. Patterns should improve how we sell, demo, position, and build.

Required Qualifications

•
You've carried a real software sales number. You can walk us through quota, attainment, average deal size, sales cycle, and what you personally sourced .

•
You're a hunter. You have created meaningful pipeline without relying primarily on SDRs, BDRs, or Marketing to hand you opportunities.

•
You've done both. New-logo selling and expansion inside existing accounts. This is not an account-management-only seat.

•
You can own a complex sale. You lead discovery and the buyer relationship, use specialists for depth, and do not disappear when the conversation gets technical.

•
You can learn a portfolio. You are comfortable selling more than one product and translating technical or financial concepts into a clear business conversation.

•
You've sold into a market where trust matters. You understand that disciplined, relevant outreach beats noise.

Preferred Qualifications:

•
Financial institution experience. Community banking, credit unions, fintech, financial software, payments, credit risk, finance, or another regulated B2B environment will help you ramp faster.

•
Experience in change. You have sold in a startup, scale-up, PE-backed, or evolving company where the process and support structure were not fully built for you.

You'll Thrive in This Role If You:

•
Create your own momentum. You do not wait for perfect leads, perfect tools, or perfect timing.

•
Ask good questions before pitching. You care more about relevance than reciting features.

title: Business Development Manager – Government (Federal, State & Local / SLED)
description:
About Phizenix

Phizenix is a technology solutions company delivering software, consulting, and IT staffing services to clients, including U.S. government prime contractors and public-sector organizations.
Position Summary
Phizenix is seeking an experienced Business Development Manager - Government/SLED/Federal to develop public-sector business, build relationships with prime contractors and government stakeholders, and identify staffing and services opportunities early in the procurement lifecycle.
The role requires working knowledge of how Federal, State, and Local agencies buy - procurement regulations, budget/legislative cycles, contract vehicles, and socio-economic contracting programs - alongside strong core business development and capture skills.
Key Responsibilities
Business Development & Pipeline

• Identify and develop new business across Federal, State, and Local Government (SLED) markets, positioning Phizenix as a qualified staffing/subcontracting partner to primes and agencies.

• Build relationships with prime contractors and conduct customer/partner outreach to uncover staffing and workforce needs.

• Manage opportunities from identification through award, maintaining an accurate pipeline (CRM/GovWin IQ or equivalent) and reporting against pipeline and revenue targets.

Government Policy, Regulatory & Compliance Awareness

• Maintain working knowledge of the FAR/DFARS and relevant state/local procurement codes, and track legislative, budget, and appropriations developments that affect agency spending and procurement timing.

• Monitor agency policy priorities and socio-economic/set-aside programs (8(a), HUBZone, SDVOSB, WOSB/EDWOSB) to inform teaming and set-aside strategy.

Contract Vehicles & Procurement Channels

• Pursue positioning on relevant contract vehicles (GSA MAS, GWACs, IDIQs, BPAs, NASPO ValuePoint) and track solicitations and sources-sought notices via SAM.gov and state SLED portals.
Capture & Proposal Support

title: Director of Actuarial Analytics and Insights
description:
Director of Actuarial Analytics and Insights

Remote Opportunity

About Reveleer

Reveleer delivers a unified platform spanning risk adjustment, quality improvement, clinical intelligence, and member management for health plans and provider organizations navigating the complexity of value-based care. Trusted by 80+ customer organizations nationwide, the platform integrates data, analytics, and intelligent workflow automation into one governed system designed to support traceable documentation across diagnoses, quality measures, and submissions. With regulatory expertise and transparent, human-in-the-loop AI at its core, Reveleer supports organizations working to advance care quality, strengthen documentation integrity, and sustain the operational readiness needed to navigate audits with confidence.

About the role

Reveleer is hiring a senior actuary to lead health plan and risk adjustment analytics for each line of business for Reveleer customers across Medicare Advantage (MA), Medicare Advantage Prescription Drug (MAPD), Affordable Care Act (ACA), Medicaid, and provider value-based contracts. This role builds member-level actuarial models that quantify risk adjustment performance, HCC (Hierarchical Condition Category) capture, medical economics, utilization, and population health trends, and translates those models into customer-facing dashboards that inform pricing, forecasting, and program strategy.

This actuary works directly with customer success, analytics, product, operations, and clinical teams to convert raw claims, encounter, member, provider, and clinical data into decision-ready outputs. The role requires both technical model-building skill and the ability to explain actuarial and risk adjustment concepts to non-actuarial stakeholders, including provider and health plan executives.

W hat you will do

• Build and maintain member-level actuarial models covering risk adjustment (RAF) performance, HCC capture and recapture, medical economics, utilization patterns, and population health metrics across MA, MAPD, ACA, and Medicaid populations.

Job Description:
Summary
EnvisionWare is hiring a Principal Architect, Systems & AI to serve as the technical truth layer for a company-wide AI-first transformation. You will own architectural integrity across a portfolio of 40+ products, use AI to map and interrogate the existing codebase, and validate every AI-generated technical claim before it becomes a decision. • Multi-stack knowledge: Java, Angular, .NET, PostgreSQL, Kubernetes (or comparable breadth)

• Ability to understand unfamiliar code quickly and challenge weak assumptions - whether from humans or AI

• Practical skepticism: you use AI aggressively but trust it only after validation

• Comfort working close to delivery, code, and teams rather than operating as a detached enterprise architect

What Success Looks Like (First 90 Days)

• Run an AI-assisted codebase crawl and produce validated system maps and dependency views

• Classify the portfolio: stabilize, modularize, modernize, retire, or selectively rewrite

• Validate any AI-generated technical findings before they appear in leadership or roadmap decisions

title: Electric Propulsion Engineer
description:
COMPANY

NewOrbit builds satellites that fly in very low Earth orbit, below 300 km, along with the electric propulsion that keeps them there.

Flying closer to Earth means sharper imagery from smaller optics, and an orbit that cleans itself: our satellites de-orbit within a month at end of life, leaving no debris.

Our AURA family of RF gridded ion thrusters powers our own NEO-1 satellite, with first flight planned for Q3 2028, and is also offered to other operators.

ROLE

Electric propulsion is what lets our satellites hold very low orbits, and our AURA RF gridded ion thruster is at the centre of it.

As Electric Propulsion Engineer, you own the design of that thruster: you calculate it, design it, build it, test it in our own vacuum facilities and feed what you learn straight into the next iteration.

You own the testing of your own designs, and your results decide what flies.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Design

- Own the design of our RF gridded ion thruster and its performance calculations, from concept to flight configuration.

- Iterate rapidly to support NEO-1 and our customer thruster deliveries.

- Work with mechanical, electrical and control engineers on each new iteration of the ion propulsion system.

Build and test

- Design and build the test rigs and equipment for propulsion testing.

- Assemble and operate test hardware, electronics and vacuum facilities.

- Run electric propulsion tests on your own designs and analyse the results.

- Plan and run the test campaigns for your own designs.

Verify

- Turn test results into design changes, then re-test.

- Document every test configuration and result so it gives traceable evidence for system verification and qualification.

REQUIREMENTS

Essential

- Strong knowledge of RF gridded ion thrusters, including RF plasma generation, ion optics and neutralisation.

- Hands-on electric propulsion testing, ideally with RF generators, high-voltage power supplies and thrust balances.

- Experience with vacuum systems (pumps, gauges, valves), power supplies, fluid management (high-pressure gas tanks, mass flow controllers) and data acquisition.

- Solid grounding in plasma physics, modelling, diagnostics and ionisation processes.

- Willingness to design, build and test your own hardware, and to work extended hours on-site.

Nice to have

- Experience taking a thruster from design through qualification to flight hardware.

- Scripting for data analysis and test automation (Python or MATLAB).

- Experience running thrusters on more than one propellant, such as xenon, krypton or air.

We are recruiting across propulsion design and test. Apply to whichever role fits you best - strong candidates may be considered for either.

WHY NEWORBIT SPACE?

- Pioneering space technology - Your work on our RF gridded ion thrusters and VLEO satellite platform will redefine satellite operations and challenge traditional LEO.

- Ownership and impact - You'll have a level of ownership that's rare in the space industry, and you'll take part in the full lifecycle of satellite technology.

- Equity and competitive salary - Alongside a competitive salary you receive a company ownership stake, so you share in the technology you help build and in our collective success.

- Comprehensive benefits - Private health insurance with dental and optical cover, and annual health check-ups.

- Hybrid working - One dedicated remote day per week.

- Visa sponsorship and relocation support - We sponsor visas and provide relocation support for candidates moving to join us.

We're hiring a Director of Data Partnerships to lead a new function at Snorkel. - Тісно співпрацювати з performance, дизайном, аналітикою й розробкою та аналізувати ключові метрики воронки й монетизації.

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, AI Performance
description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our ML Optimisation Team (AI Performance)

We're a high-ownership team responsible for delivering production-ready model releases as Wayve's OEM engagements and release cadence accelerate. We're applied and delivery-focused: we take models from "works in training" to "meets product constraints," working closely with downstream inference and performance specialists to get models ready for on-vehicle deployment.

🧠 Your day-to-day

- Owning end-to-end delivery of model releases, from initial requirements through training, evaluation, iteration and deployment readiness

- Training and iterating on PyTorch models with a hypothesis-driven approach, running ablations against clear evaluation criteria

- Debugging model performance: identifying regressions, root-causing issues and proposing fixes

- Collaborating with adjacent ML and performance engineering teams to hand off models, define bottlenecks and align on optimisation priorities

- Communicating with stakeholders on delivery timelines, trade-offs and readiness criteria

🧩 What you'll be working on

- Getting models to meet tight runtime constraints on-vehicle as model capability grows

- Applying practical optimisation techniques such as quantisation, distillation and low-rank methods, where the trade-offs make sense

- Shaping the handoff between training, evaluation and deployment, so models ship quickly and reliably

- Working at multiple levels of abstraction, from high-level model behaviour down to runtime and latency implications

🙌 You should apply if

- You have proven experience improving performance in production systems with tight constraints (latency, memory, bandwidth, power/thermal or cost)

- You have strong hands-on experience training and iterating on deep learning models in PyTorch, beyond high-level tooling

- You're proficient with at least one relevant stack or toolchain (e.g. TensorRT, CUDA, Qualcomm QNN, Triton, OpenCL) and can pick up adjacent frameworks quickly

- You're comfortable moving between high-level model behaviour and low-level kernel/runtime execution

- You're familiar with model optimisation concepts such as quantisation and/or distillation (hands-on is a strong signal, but solid fundamentals are enough)

- You have strong engineering fundamentals and collaboration skills

- Bonus: experience with models under tight latency/efficiency constraints (edge, embedded, real-time), exposure to ML systems from training through to deployment handoff, and embedded/edge deployment including benchmarking on real devices

🌱 Not ticking every box? That's totally okay! If you're passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every requirement.

More about Wayve:

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve's mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution

Here’s what this particular role covers.

At Wayve, we teach machines to drive by training end-to-end neural networks that learn from large volumes of real-world data, not by coding rules. That takes a lot of data infrastructure and compute orchestration: our workloads span thousands of GPUs, petabytes of driving data, and training and inference clusters in several regions. Our AI Infrastructure team builds the compute and storage systems behind our model development lifecycle.

🧠 Your day-to-day

As Principal Engineer, you'll design and guide how our core compute and storage systems evolve. You'll work across AI, systems and cloud infrastructure, speeding up AI research, enabling fast model deployment and keeping the platform ahead of the company's demands. You'll advise leadership on compute investment and help engineers across the org grow through architectural coaching and technical deep dives.

🧩 What you'll be working on

- Global compute strategy: defining and evolving how Wayve allocates and orchestrates training and inference workloads across thousands of GPUs and multiple data centres, for throughput, resiliency and cost efficiency

- You have enabled large-scale AI training, inference or computer vision workloads in GPU clusters

- You understand petabyte-scale data architecture in depth, including storage federation, high-throughput access and data locality for AI workloads

- You have a track record of defining and communicating architectural strategy, balancing long-term vision with delivery needs

- You mentor naturally, with a history of developing engineers and influencing technical direction across teams

- You have an advanced degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or a related field, or equivalent industry experience

Nice to have:

- Experience with multi-cloud orchestration, particularly in latency- or cost-sensitive training and inference pipelines

- Familiarity with systems like Ray, Kubernetes, Airflow or Flyte, and fluency in AI/ML job scheduling, model lifecycle management and infrastructure-as-code

- Background supporting safety-critical or real-time inference use cases (e.g. robotics, autonomous vehicles, aerospace)

- An interest in building infrastructure as a product that gives research and product teams performance and simplicity

 

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

The TechOps team is the technical foundation that is a major stakeholder in keeping the company running. Our Vision: Unlock Healthcare's Full Capacity

Health systems still run critical operations like staffing, labor planning, and capacity on spreadsheets, phone calls, and guesswork.

We’re trusted by leading health systems across the country and have raised more than $31M from top healthcare and technology investors, including our own customers.

You’ll work closely with Marketing, Sales, Product, Customer Success, and our founders to create content that builds trust, makes Vitalize easier to discover, creates demand, and ultimately drives growth.

The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. • Track record of managing external consultants and advisors across M&A workstreams, including scoping engagements, reviewing deliverables, and holding advisors to quality and timeline standards

title: Marketing Coordinator (Contract)
description:
At Pivot + Edge , we’re not your typical recruitment agency. We’re rethinking how recruitment gets done. We support mission-driven companies attract, engage, and hire top talent without the agency fluff or inflated fees.
We’ve built a best-in-class process and strategy that changes how companies think about recruiting. And we’re just getting started.
We combine recruitment expertise, marketing and the right infrastructure to help growing organizations attract better candidates and build stronger hiring processes.
We’re a small, collaborative team that values curiosity, ownership and people who are always looking for a better way to do the work.
What You’ll Do
Pivot + Edge is looking for a contract marketing professional to help us turn ideas into consistent, polished content.
We already have the strategy, subject matter expertise and plenty of ideas. We’re looking for someone who can help us execute: creating social content, editing short-form video and keeping marketing activities moving week to week.
This is a flexible, part-time contract opportunity for someone who is comfortable jumping between content creation, video editing and general marketing execution.
You’ll work closely with our marketing team to:

• Create and schedule social media content, primarily for LinkedIn

• Turn ideas, notes and existing content into polished social posts

• Edit short-form video content for LinkedIn and other social channels

• Add captions, simple graphics, branding and formatting to video

• Repurpose longer-form content into shorter social assets

• Support basic graphic and content creation using tools like Canva

• Help maintain a consistent content calendar and publishing cadence

• Support other marketing execution as needed

Requirements
What We’re Looking For
You don’t need to be an expert in every area, but you should be someone who can take direction and independently get things done.
You’re likely a strong fit if you:

• Have experience creating content for social media

• Are comfortable editing short-form video

• Understand what makes content work on LinkedIn

• Have strong writing and editing skills

• Can work within an established brand voice

• Are comfortable using Canva and common content creation tools

• Are organized and able to manage multiple small deliverables

• Can take an idea or rough direction and turn it into a finished piece

• Are comfortable receiving feedback and iterating quickly

• Bring ideas forward when you see an opportunity to make something better

Nice to Have
Experience with any of the following would be an asset:

• B2B marketing

• Recruitment or employer branding

• LinkedIn company page management

• Content scheduling platforms

• Basic graphic design

title: Entwicklungsingenieur:in Elektrische Heizsysteme / Prozessgaserhitzer (w/m/d)
description: Über Hyca Heat Hyca Heat ist ein deutsches Deep-Tech-Startup an der Spitze der industriellen Energiewende. Wir entwickeln eine weltweit einzigartige, patentierte Heiztechnologie, die hocheffiziente katalytische Verbrennung mit elektrischer Beheizung kombiniert, und dekarbonisieren damit die Prozesswärmeindustrie. Unser Team aus erfahrenen Ingenieuren, Unternehmern und Wissenschaftlern arbeitet in Jülich an einer der größten Herausforderungen unserer Zeit. Deine Mission Wir suchen eine:n erfahrene:n Ingenieur:in für die Auslegung und Entwicklung elektrischer Hochtemperatur-Heizsysteme (w/m/d) für unser Team in Jülich. Hybrid-Position mit in der Regel 1-2 Homeoffice-Tagen pro Woche. Du verantwortest das Herzstück unserer Anlagen: die elektrische Widerstandsheizung unserer Prozessgaserhitzer. Die Besonderheit unserer Technologie: Der Heizleiter ist zugleich die Trägerstruktur des Katalysators - elektrische Beheizung, Wärmeübertragung und katalytische Verbrennung finden in einem einzigen Bauteil statt. Geometrie, Werkstoff, Temperaturprofil und Beschichtung lassen sich nicht unabhängig voneinander optimieren. Genau das macht die Aufgabe anspruchsvoll. Deine Aufgaben Auslegung elektrischer Widerstandsheizer und Prozessgaserhitzer: Oberflächenbelastung, Heizleitertemperatur, Widerstands- und Leistungsauslegung sowie Wärmeübergang in gasdurchströmten Systemen. Werkstoffauswahl unter realen Atmosphären: FeCrAl und NiCr/Nickelbasis gegen die tatsächliche Gaszusammensetzung - Oxidation, Aufkohlung, Nitrierung, Schwefel- und Wasserdampfeinfluss. Auslegung der Heizleiterstruktur als Katalysatorträger: Zusammenspiel von Geometrie, Oberfläche und Temperaturprofil mit der katalytischen Beschichtung - Beschichtbarkeit, Schichthaftung und Alterung. Thermomechanik und konstruktive Integration: Wärmedehnung und Dehnungsausgleich, Kriechen, Zyklenfestigkeit, Strömungsführung und Vermeidung von Hot-Spots.

title: Manager, Valuation
description:
Position Summary
Vista Equity Partners is seeking to hire a Manager to support the valuation function for Vista’s private equity investments. The manager will be responsible for the oversight and coordination of quarterly and monthly valuations. Successful candidates will have a strong foundation in generally accepted valuation approaches and a solid understanding of private equity funds and strategies. This is a high-visibility, high-accountability role that requires thriving under tight deadlines and competing priorities in a fast-paced environment. Strong written and oral communication skills, along with strong interpersonal skills, are also critical, as the Manager will regularly engage with colleagues across the Finance team and the broader firm, including firm leaders, investment professionals, and Investor Relations as well as external service providers.
Responsibilities

• Coordinate the quarterly valuation process for private equity investments by working closely with investment professionals, external valuation providers and internal stakeholders

• Perform detailed reviews of internal models for integrity and consistency with valuation policies and procedures

• Participate in the quarterly Private Equity valuation process, which includes engagement with senior executives

• Create presentation materials for internal and external meetings

• Provide technical leadership on complex valuation topics

• Contribute to valuation policies and procedures and recommend enhancements in line with best practices

• Perform various performance metrics, including IRR, MOIC and ad-hoc portfolio analysis

• Interface with investor relation team on investor reporting or marketing materials related to valuation

• Contribute to process and technology initiatives to streamline valuation and performance reporting

Qualifications

• Undergraduate BS or BA, or a Graduate MS or MBA degree in Finance or Accounting

• 5+ years of valuation related work experience

• CFA and/or CPA preferred but not required

• Previous managerial experience including team leadership, development and resource planning

• Strong oral and written communication skills including strong presentation skills

• Strong interpersonal skills with a demonstrated ability to work effectively as part of a team and across an organization

• High level of integrity and ability to maintain confidentiality of sensitive and proprietary information

• Strong organizational skills, attention to detail and commitment to high-quality work product

The annualized base pay range for this role is expected to be between $140,000-182,000. Actual base pay could vary based on factors including but not limited to experience, subject matter expertise, geographic location where work will be performed and the applicant’s skill set. The base pay is just one component of the total compensation package for employees. Other components may include an annual cash bonus and a comprehensive benefits package.
Company Overview
Vista is a leading global investment firm that exclusively invests in enterprise software, data and technology-enabled organizations across private equity, permanent capital, credit and public equity strategies, bringing an approach that prioritizes creating enduring market value for the benefit of its global ecosystem of investors, companies, customers and employees. Vista’s investments are anchored by a sizable long-term capital base, experience in structuring technology-oriented transactions and proven, flexible management techniques that drive sustainable growth. Vista believes the transformative power of technology is the key to an even better future - a healthier planet, a smarter economy, a diverse and inclusive community and a broader path to prosperity. Further information is available at vistaequitypartners.com. Follow Vista on LinkedIn, @ Vista Equity Partners , and on X, @Vista_Equity.

title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer - Platform

Ditto is redefining how data moves at the edge. Our mission is to make it seamless for developers to build resilient, real-time applications, regardless of network conditions. Whether you're in a stadium, airplane, or remote military base, Ditto's peer-to-peer sync engine ensures devices stay connected and data stays consistent, even without internet. With more than $145 million in funding and trusted by organizations like Chick-fil-A, Delta Airlines, and the U.S. military, Ditto powers mission-critical experiences across aviation, retail, travel, hospitality, defense, and more. As a globally distributed, fast-growing startup, we’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive team that reflects the wide range of perspectives needed to solve the world’s hardest connectivity problems.

As a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE), you are the technical tip of the spear. FDEs are elite, versatile engineers who work shoulder-to-shoulder with our most critical users to solve complex challenges in real time. Your primary mission is to radically decrease the time-to-value of our software by integrating it directly into the user's operational environment.

Because you see firsthand how our technology performs in the wild, you will also act as a crucial conduit, feeding technical insights and feature requirements back to our core product engineering team. This role requires a highly adaptable problem-solver who is comfortable moving fast, navigating ambiguity, and figuring things out quickly in high-stakes environments.

- Bridge the Gap: Translate the unique, edge-case operational realities you observe (e.g., ATO constraints, network segmentation at the SOCOM enterprise level, cross-domain latency) into actionable technical requirements for the core product development team.

- Lead Technical Customer Engagement: Work directly with operational users and Government technical stakeholders to understand mission workflows, integration needs, environmental constraints, and deployment readiness. Communicate technical progress, dependencies, and issues in coordination with the Program Manager.

• Comfortable owning a workstream end-to-end with light oversight: you'll get direction on weekly priorities and outcomes, but will be trusted to set your own week and say no to the right things.

title: Manager, Brand Engagement - WWF International
description:
Want to make a positive difference to the future of people and our one shared home, the Earth? Working at WWF could be your opportunity of a lifetime.
All around the world, people are waking up to the devastating impacts of climate change and nature loss. The situation today is worse than the darkest predictions of just ten years ago, pushing billions of people to the edge and threatening lives and livelihoods. At WWF, we are facing our biggest crisis - and our biggest ever opportunity - to create a better future for people and nature. With over 60 years of experience and an active presence in more than 100 countries, we work to achieve both on-the-ground and global policy action, from protecting and restoring species and their habitats, to transforming markets and policies toward sustainability.
Our people come from hugely diverse backgrounds and with a variety of expertise, ranging from conservation science and advocacy to HR and finance. We welcome applications from anyone who believes they can help us tackle this enormous global challenge and drive the urgent conservation impact needed to restore our planet.
What We Do We are an independent conservation organization, striving to sustain the natural world for the benefit of people and the ecosystem. From individuals and communities to businesses and governments, we are part of a growing global movement calling for bolder action on climate and nature, demanding that world leaders set nature on the path to recovery by 2030. WWF works to address the most dominant drivers of nature loss through system-wide changes in how food and energy are produced and consumed, and in how financial systems are structured. By implementing change in every country, we aim to drive visible and positive impacts on the ground, helping to restore nature in the most critical places around the world, from the Amazon to the Coral Triangle.
Engaging everyone means addressing the barriers to participation faced by some groups in society, including local communities. Conservation will only be sustainable if it is owned by, and benefits, local people. That’s why Indigenous Peoples and local communities must be at the centre of action on climate and nature. WWF is committed to using its resources and global network to support these communities in creating together the most effective solutions where they live.
Humanity is still in time, we have a clear pathway to solve this crisis. At WWF, we call on everyone to join the global movement, change how we live, and take action now.
